card.name: Scattered words in oncology and MS labels
card.fires_on: No single word type; it fires on scattered tokens in prescribing text for cancer and multiple sclerosis drugs, such as parts of brand names (MYLOTARG, ZEPOSIA, tretinoin) and ordinary words like distinct, residual, contains.
